design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark-themed personal tech hub with strong hero hierarchy, a consistent design system (accent gradients, colored card links, glassy panels), and clear interactive flows (login modal, chat consent gate). Main weaknesses are layout collisions on mobile (floating Voice Agent/chat widgets overlap content in the mobile menu view), low-contrast secondary text, and thin accessibility signaling (small controls, no visible focus/label affordances).
strengths: ui-home-desktop: Clear hero hierarchy — large display headline 'AI Testing & Integration. Building Trust.' with accent-colored emphasis, supporting paragraph, stat band, and two distinct CTAs (Live Feed primary gradient, AI Lab secondary).

ui-primary-navigation: Top nav is well ordered with clear separation between content links (Feed…Digest), a visually distinct 'Break it' action (red pill), and utility actions (settings icon, Login button) on the right.

ui-login-modal: Modal uses a dimmed/blurred backdrop to focus attention, clear Login/Register tabs with active-state underline, labeled Email/Password fields with placeholders, a prominent gradient Login button, and a Forgot password link.

ui-chat-consent: Consent gate before chat shows a disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' button until the checkbox is ticked, links 'terms of use', and states AI limitations — good progressive disclosure and transparency.
ui-chat-opens/consent: Chat panel has a clear header with status ('Online'), recognizable controls (clear, refresh, close), a visible text input with placeholder, and a send affordance.

Consistent visual language across screens: same dark palette, accent gradient (blue→purple→cyan), status colors (green 'Passed', amber 'Warning'), and per-card action colors (Explore/Scan/Verify/Check) all follow one system.
ui-mobile-menu: Full-screen menu provides large, well-spaced tap targets and a prominent close (×) control; 'Break it' remains a distinct destructive-styled action.
issues: ui-mobile-menu: Floating Voice Agent pill and chat bubble overlap the 'Adversarial Simulation' card text on mobile — content is obscured and tap targets collide; these widgets should hide, stack, or shrink at small viewports.
ui-mobile-menu: The menu overlay partially leaves underlying page content visible/scrollable-looking below the nav, creating ambiguity about what is interactive while the menu is open.

Contrast: Muted secondary text (e.g., 'Stress-test your AI with realistic attack scenarios.', stat labels 'ARTICLES TODAY' / 'RSS SOURCES') is very low-contrast gray on dark backgrounds and likely fails WCAG AA at its size.
ui-login-modal: No visible error/required-field indicators, password visibility toggle, or hints of focus states; accessibility for form validation is not demonstrated.

Accessibility cues: No evidence of focus indicators, ARIA labeling, or keyboard affordances in any screenshot; the 'LIVE' vertical badge and icon-only buttons (settings, chat clear/refresh) rely on color/shape alone.

ui-chat-consent: The consent panel occupies the full right column with mostly empty space before agreement — content above (cards) is clipped behind it, and on smaller widths this overlap could hide primary content.
ui-home-desktop: The 'AI TEST RESULT' mock widget's terminal text is clipped ('--workers=4' cut at edge), and small green labels in the PASS card are near the minimum readable size.
